responsibility: Implements the VxWorks-specific Rust frontend target hook object by overriding TARGET_RUST_OS_INFO. It publishes VxWorks Rust target metadata through rust_add_target_info, identifying the unix family, vxworks OS, wrs vendor, and gnu environment, and then exports those hooks via targetrustm. This file is confined to Rust frontend target-info reporting and does not implement the broader VxWorks specs or backend helpers found in vxworks.h and vxworks.cc.
